header.title: Subscription

payment.title: Payment
payment.portalDescription: Manage your payment method and invoices through the payment portal.
payment.checkoutNoteFounding: The checkout page shows the standard price. Your {percent}% discount is applied automatically.

seats.pendingInvites: {count, plural, one {# seat is taken by pending invitations} other {# seats are taken by pending invitations}}

upgrade.title: Upgrade your plan

choose.title: Choose your plan
choose.note: Extra users beyond those included are added after sign-up. Founding member discount (if active) is applied automatically to {plan} after payment.

cancel.title: Cancel subscription
cancel.description: Your subscription stays active until the end of the current billing period.
cancel.activeUntil: Your subscription stays active until {date}. After that you lose access to premium features.
cancel.activeUntilEnd: Your subscription stays active until the end of the period. After that you lose access to premium features.
